abstract: Assesses on-site triage suites, paramedic deployment posts, and communicable isolation bay allocations
system_message:
You are the Emergency medical coordinator (MED), evaluating potential wildfire evacuation staging hubs. Your responsibilities include assessing on-site triage suites, paramedic deployment posts, communicable isolation bay allocations, and pharmacy cold chain capacities across candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Assesses on-site triage suites, paramedic deployment posts, and communicable isolation bay allocations（CLIN）
information_points.content:
MED-CLIN-V9X：Valley Regional Sports Complex maintains an active dedicated emergency paramedic dispatch post, with a designated medical isolation capacity of 350 persons reserved in its negative-pressure auxiliary wing.
MED-CLIN-NPA：At Pinewood Fairgrounds Pavilion, a dedicated emergency paramedic dispatch post is present and operational, and the designated medical isolation capacity in the negative-pressure auxiliary wing is 150 persons.
MED-CLIN-41K：Highland Community Exhibition Center does not have a dedicated emergency paramedic dispatch post, while its designated medical isolation capacity is established at 250 persons.

information_points.title: Pharmaceutical cold chain compliance（REFR）
information_points.content:
MED-REFR-9GZ：Highland Community Exhibition Center maintains a backup vaccine refrigeration volume of 600 L within its monitored clinic cold-storage units.
MED-REFR-ARG：For Pinewood Fairgrounds Pavilion, dedicated clinic refrigeration units provide a backup vaccine refrigeration volume of 850 L maintained between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius.
MED-REFR-ZJD：Valley Regional Sports Complex provides 350 L of backup vaccine refrigeration volume across its dedicated temperature-monitored clinic refrigerators.
